title: The Presence of God
subtitle: What his presence is like, how his people sought it, how Jesus walked in it, and how it comes to live in us
summary: "You will fill me with joy in Your presence" (Psalm 16:11). Scripture begins with God walking in a garden with the people he made, and ends with his dwelling among them and his face in view. In between it is a story of distance and nearness: a bush that burns, a cloud and a fire, a tent and a temple filled with glory, a whisper on a mountain. Then the Word becomes flesh and lives among us, walking every day in the Father's presence, and the Spirit is given so that his people become his temple. The second view follows how Jesus himself walked with the Father.
